app.title: Rinde
app.tagline: Does my salary last the month?

health.heading: System status
health.ok: The API and the database are up.
health.unavailable: The API responds, but the database is unavailable.

brand.label: About Rinde
brand.privacy: No email and no personal data: just a username.
brand.security: Passwords handled the way NIST recommends.
brand.currencies: Pesos, dollars and installments in one place.
brand.footnote: Each square is a day of the month: aqua ones are covered by your salary.

fields.usernameHelp: 3 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, dot, hyphen or underscore.
fields.passwordHelp: {{length}} of at least {{min}} characters. A phrase is safer and easier to remember: “my cat eats noodles on tuesdays”.
fields.recoveryCodeHelp: 20 letters and numbers. You can type it with or without hyphens.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: No email and no personal data: just a username and a phrase you remember.

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.subtitle: With the code you saved when you created it. You will choose a new password and every open session will be closed.

code.confirm: I saved the code somewhere safe

session.waking: Waking up the server: the first visit of the day can take up to a minute.
